title: Staff approvals of Lahaina historic district rebuilds
summary: On September 3, staff said four rebuild projects in the historic district were approved administratively as close matches to pre-fire buildings; approvals require construction to start within two years, and a building permit is still needed. Projects differing more than 10 percent from before go to the commission. The vice chair has objected that staff approval skips commission review and public testimony.

timeline.text: The County streamlined the SMA permit process for qualifying Lahaina reconstruction. Under Recovery Coordination Directive No. 10, the Planning Director can process these applications administratively instead of sending them through a public hearing before the Maui Planning Commission.

source.quote: 10), qualifying reconstruction project applications may be processed administratively by the Planning Director rather than proceeding through the standard public hearing process before the Maui Planning Commission.

timeline.text: The regular October 1, 2026 Cultural Resources Commission meeting was canceled. That was the next meeting where HDX tracking lists and historic district rebuild reviews were due.

source.quote: Maui County Cultural Resources Commission - Canceled.

timeline.text: Staff said the historic district approval is step one, and a building permit is still needed.
Staff said projects that differ more than 10 percent from before come to the commission.
The vice chair said the approval letters require construction to begin within two years.
Staff said four rebuild projects in the historic district were approved by staff as close matches to pre-fire buildings.
Staff said one HDX will come to the commission in September because it goes beyond a like-for-like rebuild.
The vice chair said she disagrees with staff approving HDXs because it skips commission review and public testimony.
Staff agreed to post lists of approved and in-review HDXs for future meetings.
Staff reported five HDX applications approved by staff since April, and five more in review.
